Characters over level 10 will lose a certain percentage of their experience points and zen when they die.
Press Q, W, E to use the items such as healing potion, mana potion, antidote, alcohol or town portal scroll registered under those keys.
Lorencia's Vault Coordinates: (140, 110), (147, 144)
Lorencia's Vault Coordinates: (173, 95)
Vault usage fee is deducted from your inventory according to your level.
Use the lock function on your vault to protect it.

The entrance to Noria in Lorencia is at coordinates 214, 244.
The entrance to Lorencia in Noria is at coordinates 153, 5
Press space bar to collect loot.
Hanzo the Blacksmith in Lorencia who sells knight equipment is located at coordinates 117, 140
Pasi the Mage in Lorencia who sells wizard equipment is located at coordinates 119, 112.
The Peddler in Lorencia who sells beginner's equipment is at coordinates 183, 136.
Elf Lala in Noria who sells beginner's equipment is located at coordinate 173, 124.
Eo The Craftsman in Noria who sells elf equipment is at coordinates 196,124.
5 stat points are rewarded each time you level up.
To combat normally, left click on monster.
To use skill during combat, right click on monster.
Right click on scrolls or orbs to master the noted skills.
My Friend function is accessible only from level 6.
To use skills or magic, right click on monster.
The command (trade, party, whisper, etc.) system is accessible by pressing the 'D' key.
Only the level above 10 can use the Chaos Goblin.
Only the level above 6 can use the personal store. The commands are '/personal store' and '/purchase', it can be created by shortcut key S.
Use '/View store on' and '/View store off' to set the command for viewing/closing the personal store.
Click shortcut key T to check the quest information.
You must be at least level 20 to enter the Dungeon.
The entrance to the Dungeon is at coordinates 122, 231 in Lorencia.
Pressing ctrl+E while keeping the cursor on the item (alcohol, antidote, and town portal scroll) will register a shortcut key for the item.
Wearing a level +5 or above boots allows you to run.
When poisoned, your character becomes green and continues to receive damage for 10 seconds.
When poisoned, you can cure yourself by using the antidote.
Using the 'town portal scroll' will transport you to the nearest town or safe area.
To save a screenshot in your Mu folder, press the 'Print Screen' key.
Item's performance level decreases when the durability decreases.
To set macro for chatting, type '/number(1~10) <message>'
To use the saved chatting macro, press Alt+number.
To fix your weapon or armor, go to the weapon merchants in town.
To send a message to party members, type '~ message'
To send a message to guild members, type '@ message'
To trade items or zen with another character, type '/trade' while keeping the cursor on the opposite character.
The wizard in Devias who sells mid level wizard items is at coordinate 225, 50.
The weapon merchant in Devias who sells mid level equipment is at coordinate 188, 46.
Devias' Vault Coordinates: (218, 61)
The supplementary magic of the Elf can be used by clicking the name in the party window.

Jewel of Chaos is used to combining items.
You can raise weapon/armor/wing level up to 6 by using the Jewel of Bless.
You can raise weapon/armor/wing level up to 9 by using the Jewel of Soul.
The success rate of the Jewel of Soul is 50%. The rate increases by 25% if the item has luck option attached.
The item's level may decrease if the upgrade fails with the Jewel of Soul.
To invite someone to your party, type '/party' while keeping the cursor on the character.
The defense rate increases by 10% when your armor set is of the same type.
Excellent type item names are displayed in green.
Vault usage fee increases as your character level increases.
Critical Damage (max damage) is displayed in light blue.
Excellent Damage (110% of max damage) is displayed in green.
The Chaos Goblin in Noria who combines items is at coordinates 180, 102.
At level 100, you can become a guild master.
The Guild Advocate NPC who registers guilds is in Devias at coordinate 215, 44.
Alex in Lorencia who sells mid level items is at coordinate 63, 130.
Thompson Kenel the Weapon Merchant in Devias who sells mid level items is at coordinates 9, 76.
